title: Correctness of a recursive call
statement: Fix an input bit string $x$, a natural-number bound $B$, a Boolean list $qs$, and a CNF formula $\varphi$ over natural-number variables. The call is correct at depth $k$ if, for every assignment stack $S<2^{k+1}$, the machine runs from the node label with initial state of depth $k$, stack $S$, and pointer $0$ to the return label carrying the truth value of the quantified formula at $(k,S)$, with the same initial state restored.
caveat: The exact operational meanings of the run relation and the quantified-formula truth predicate are not included in the snippet.
